name: scroll-world
description: Build an immersive scroll-scrubbed 'fly through the world' landing page for any industry or brand, generated on Replicate (gpt-image-2 stills + frame-locked Seedance 2.0 camera clips). As the visitor scrolls, a pre-rendered camera flies from outside each scene into its interior, then flows on to the next with no cuts. Interviews for topic, story beats, brand kit, camera style and a dollar budget; wires a portable, framework-agnostic scrub engine.
